title: Sickle cell variants, hemolytic and aplastic anemia, hemophilia, neutropenia
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood disorder (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hemoglobin SC disease.

HPI
Pt is a 63 y/o female presenting for routine follow-up of sickle cell-hemoglobin C disease. She reports feeling well today. Denies any acute pain or recent episodes of illness. She states she has been managing symptoms well at home. No new concerns reported since last visit.

Medication List
Hydroxyurea 500mg BID
Folic acid 1mg daily
Hydration fluids PRN

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, regular rate and rhythm.
Resp: CTAB, no wheezes.
Skin: No new lesions noted.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Sickle cell-hemoglobin C disease. Pt is currently stable. No signs of acute distress or recent complications.

Plan
1. Continue current medication regimen as prescribed.
2. Continue routine monitoring of CBC and reticulocyte count.
3. F/u in 6 months.

Electronically signed, E. Castillo, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Sickle cell-hemoglobin C disease without crisis: D57.20 (HCC 108).

distractors.why: Hb SC is a separate sickle cell disorder (HCC 108), not Hb-SS.
It is a disease, not the trait.
